title: docsearch has the old Algolia logo
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

![screen shot 2017-02-14 at 09 48 38](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6270048/22923550/3ae1205a-f2a2-11e6-86ad-9dd67b1a1bb0.png)

docsearch has the old logo

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

all

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch
